answers.core: This proposal is about bringing visual shader functionality closer to writing shader code when it comes to per-instance uniforms.
answers.workaround: It's possible to use a `VisualShaderNodeGlobalExpression` node to declare the hinted per-instance uniforms, and assign them to variables with a `VisualShaderNodeExpression` node for use with other nodes in the graph. However, being able to set this hint in `VisualShaderNodeParameter` directly would be a lot more convenient, requiring less setup and less input of code.

title: Allow instance_index hint to be set inside a VisualShaderNodeParameter
